Cross-language JCS+SHA-256 vectors match `contracts/digest-vectors.json` byte-for-byte for all three registry domains, including exact one-NUL framing and lowercase `sha256:` output.

The intent DTO has exact `fleet.command-intent/v1` keys including `owner_policy_ref`; changing that precondition conflicts, while delivery ID/wait budget/output/dry-run do not change the intent digest.
Wire result/command schema IDs are exactly `fleet.command/v1` and `fleet.result/v1`; unknown IDs reject/degrade rather than silently coercing.

Duplicate properties, invalid Unicode, non-finite numbers and lossy numeric IDs fail before operation acceptance; property-order/whitespace vectors are invariant; arrays and strings are preserved by JCS.
compatibility: Preserve existing owner, queue, status, resource identity, and Fleet gh boundaries; no silent coercion.
cost_risk: Medium; review source-specific size/risk before applying. Highest risks are false parity, shared-file collisions, schema ownership, remote partial effects, and overclaiming mocks/deployment.

The conformance test compares RFC 8785 canonical bytes/hash against independent cross-language golden vectors and negative input cases.

negative_tests: imported cycles quarantined; incomplete traversal cannot return ready; unresolved external hard ref blocks; hierarchy/parent does not block.
oracle: Source-specified model/golden/invariant with a decidable expected result.

cost_risk: Medium; review source-specific size/risk before applying. Highest risks are false parity, shared-file collisions, schema ownership, remote partial effects, and overclaiming mocks/deployment.

acceptance: verified matching task/session sends once; unbound shell sends never; unsupported adapter says unsupported; Slack delivered is not ack; retry after timeout reconciles. Contract corpus proves capability and receipt distinctions, operation correlation, and redaction. Command: `cargo test --manifest-path pkgs/fleet/Cargo.toml -p fleet-queue --lib --features client,queue-broker pmo_dsp_05_send_requires_verified_task_binding`; fake PM adapter: `cd pm-stack/dispatch && bun test test/session-delivery.test.ts`. -
compatibility: Preserve existing owner, queue, status, resource identity, and Fleet gh boundaries; no silent coercion.
cost_risk: Medium; review source-specific size/risk before applying. Highest risks are false parity, shared-file collisions, schema ownership, remote partial effects, and overclaiming mocks/deployment.
done_command: verified matching task/session sends once; unbound shell sends never; unsupported adapter says unsupported; Slack delivered is not ack; retry after timeout reconciles. enables: Only the explicitly sequenced dependent contract or adapter slices; not a domain starter's completion or a runtime capability by itself.
goal: deliver instruction only to the task's authoritative currently-bound session and expose provider-specific capability/ack states. -
horizon: after design-document merge and granular prerequisites; schema/runtime work has a separate gate
negative_tests: stale, ambiguous, unauthorized, duplicate/replay, partial/unknown effect, and false-completion cases as applicable

Command: `cargo test --manifest-path pkgs/fleet/Cargo.toml -p fleet-queue --lib --features client,queue-broker pmo_dsp_07`; first prove `pmo_dsp_07` is listed with `-- --list` because zero-test success is not acceptance. A separately authorized live run against the existing #6533 fixture supplies evidence or records a blocker. This design does not launch production agents; passing unit tests does not close live acceptance. -
compatibility: Preserve existing owner, queue, status, resource identity, and Fleet gh boundaries; no silent coercion.
cost_risk: Medium; review source-specific size/risk before applying. Highest risks are false parity, shared-file collisions, schema ownership, remote partial effects, and overclaiming mocks/deployment.
done_command: automated validator rejects each omitted field (`Result` outcome/reason, effect source-before/source-after, task/session binding, prompt delivery and progress proof) with the golden receipt corpus. Command: `cargo test --manifest-path pkgs/fleet/Cargo.toml -p fleet-queue --lib --features client,queue-broker pmo_dsp_07`; first prove `pmo_dsp_07` is listed with `-- --list` because zero-test success is not acceptance. A separately authorized live run against the existing #6533 fixture supplies evidence or records a blocker. This design does not launch production agents; passing unit tests does not close live acceptance. -
enables: Only the explicitly sequenced dependent contract or adapter slices; not a domain starter's completion or a runtime capability by itself.
goal: define and verify one complete launch receipt through live handoff/dispatch. -
horizon: after design-document merge and granular prerequisites; schema/runtime work has a separate gate
negative_tests: stale, ambiguous, unauthorized, duplicate/replay, partial/unknown effect, and false-completion cases as applicable
oracle: synthetic success mocks missing prompt ack, bind, or meaningful progress cannot satisfy the fixture; a session ID alone and a queued issue are rejected. -

source_refs.source_section: 10. Titles, Descriptions, Comments, and Synchronization Authority
10. Titles, Descriptions, Comments, and Synchronization Authority

rollback: Disable new path; preserve prior state, data, pending intents, and remote effects.
title: design(pm-orchestration): Accepted-intent write records work version + decision provenance + required operation intent through existing broker. Owns proposed src/work/distribution.rs, shared src/work/contracts.rs, integration src/turso_queue.rs

acceptance: Extend existing Projector webhook intake as authenticated bounded transport/dedup, then fan out a typed field-scoped operation through the existing Fleet authority adapter; no new service. Reuse `pm-stack/projector/src/server.ts` route, `src/webhook.ts` HMAC/bounded-body helper, delivery ledger and hot-cursor protocol; test at `pm-stack/projector/test/priority-webhook.test.ts` plus Fleet authority module.

Use #7030's existing Drew-only protected membership/value policy; exact authenticated owner action is the only path to amend it, and all routine/manual/automatic/label/mobile/slash changes fail closed without altering the protected item. No re-ratification.
compatibility: Preserve existing owner, queue, status, resource identity, and Fleet gh boundaries; no silent coercion.
cost_risk: Medium; review source-specific size/risk before applying. Highest risks are false parity, shared-file collisions, schema ownership, remote partial effects, and overclaiming mocks/deployment.
done_command: cargo test --manifest-path pkgs/fleet/Cargo.toml -p fleet-queue --lib --features client,queue-broker pmo_distribution_priority_webhook_maps_to_shared_command (verify exact test name with -- --list first). Also verify `pmo_distribution_protected_expedite_label_event_is_denied` is listed, then run `cargo test --manifest-path pkgs/fleet/Cargo.toml -p fleet-queue --lib --features client,queue-broker pmo_distribution_protected_expedite_label_event_is_denied`.
enables: Only the explicitly sequenced dependent contract or adapter slices; not a domain starter's completion or a runtime capability by itself.
goal: Map already-authenticated, delivery-deduplicated priority label/removal events into the shared Fleet command contract and reconcile echoes without granting the disposable projector authority. Reuse existing HMAC intake/hot ledger; add no policy or remote mutation to webhook.ts.
horizon: after design-document merge and granular prerequisites; schema/runtime work has a separate gate
negative_tests: stale, ambiguous, unauthorized, duplicate/replay, partial/unknown effect, and false-completion cases as applicable
oracle: Source-specified model/golden/invariant with a decidable expected result.

title: design(pm-orchestration): Pagination, API caps, and resumable durable page ingestion

acceptance: per source/resource/endpoint/query/API cursor; cursor post-durable; overlap not proof; deletion gap reported.
compatibility: Preserve existing owner, queue, status, resource identity, and Fleet gh boundaries; no silent coercion.
cost_risk: Medium; review source-specific size/risk before applying. Highest risks are false parity, shared-file collisions, schema ownership, remote partial effects, and overclaiming mocks/deployment.
done_command: confirm both listed with `cargo test --manifest-path pkgs/fleet/Cargo.toml -p fleet-queue --lib --features client,queue-broker -- --list`; then run `cargo test --manifest-path pkgs/fleet/Cargo.toml -p fleet-queue --lib --features client,queue-broker pmo_hyd_refresh_observes_edit_behind_creation_cursor` and the same command filtered by `pmo_hyd_replay_deduplicates_revision_not_creation`.
enables: Only the explicitly sequenced dependent contract or adapter slices; not a domain starter's completion or a runtime capability by itself.
goal: detect new comments and edits to older comments, retain revision/tombstone/minimized observations, distinguish occurrence/observation/update times.
horizon: after design-document merge and granular prerequisites; schema/runtime work has a separate gate
negative_tests: equal `updated_at`, shifting pages, absent deletion, minimized records.
oracle: Source-specified model/golden/invariant with a decidable expected result.

compatibility: Preserve existing owner, queue, status, resource identity, and Fleet gh boundaries; no silent coercion.
cost_risk: Medium; review source-specific size/risk before applying. Highest risks are false parity, shared-file collisions, schema ownership, remote partial effects, and overclaiming mocks/deployment.
done_command: verify test listed, then `cargo test --manifest-path pkgs/fleet/Cargo.toml -p fleet-queue --lib --features client,queue-broker pmo_hyd_refresh_timeout_returns_resumable_cursor_receipt`. Shared CLI acceptance belongs its owner and has a separate named golden help/JSON test.
enables: Only the explicitly sequenced dependent contract or adapter slices; not a domain starter's completion or a runtime capability by itself.
goal: implement bounded `hydrate`, `refresh`, `changes`, `activity reconcile`, `watch` service behavior mapped to shared contracts.
horizon: after design-document merge and granular prerequisites; schema/runtime work has a separate gate
negative_tests: ambiguous resource, unsupported include advertised, timeout returns success or fictional cancellation, watch spawns hidden poller.
oracle: Source-specified model/golden/invariant with a decidable expected result.

title: design(pm-orchestration): Private note CRUD/search and status-reason separation

acceptance: confirm test listed then run exact package filter `pmo_journal_checkpoint_round_trip_preserves_cursor_and_commit_refs`.
compatibility: Preserve existing owner, queue, status, resource identity, and Fleet gh boundaries; no silent coercion.
cost_risk: Medium; review source-specific size/risk before applying. Highest risks are false parity, shared-file collisions, schema ownership, remote partial effects, and overclaiming mocks/deployment.
done_command: confirm test listed then run exact package filter `pmo_journal_checkpoint_round_trip_preserves_cursor_and_commit_refs`.
enables: Only the explicitly sequenced dependent contract or adapter slices; not a domain starter's completion or a runtime capability by itself.
goal: journal checkpoint reference includes objective, done/remaining, paths, branch/commit, test state, blocker edges, hydration/cursor refs and next action; handoff never implies completion.
horizon: after design-document merge and granular prerequisites; schema/runtime work has a separate gate
negative_tests: stale checkpoint silently current, secret path, no commit identity, pending test shown passed.
oracle: Source-specified model/golden/invariant with a decidable expected result.

title: design(pm-orchestration): Intrinsic/nullable-importance/effective-pressure explanation types and profile boundary in pkgs/fleet/crates/fleet-queue/src/work/priority.rs. No duplicate DB

acceptance: Required before/after peer ordering within equal effective urgency; exact integer rank and local deterministic rebalance in `pkgs/fleet/crates/fleet-queue/src/work/priority.rs`; comparator parity in `pkgs/fleet/crates/fleet-queue/src/turso_queue.rs`.
With otherwise equal comparator fields, authority-qualified work ID `9` sorts before `10` numerically despite string wire representation; provider/session IDs are never parsed as work IDs.

Order DTO uses exact `fleet.selection-order/v1` registry domain/framing, has the entire ordered eligible population and owner-policy reference, and fails to emit a conformant hash for partial/truncated candidate snapshots.
compatibility: Preserve existing owner, queue, status, resource identity, and Fleet gh boundaries; no silent coercion.
cost_risk: Medium; review source-specific size/risk before applying. Highest risks are false parity, shared-file collisions, schema ownership, remote partial effects, and overclaiming mocks/deployment.
done_command: Verify `pmo_peer_rank_rebalances_local_range` and `pmo_work_id_decimal_strings_order_numeric_not_lexical` are listed; then run both exact fleet-queue filters. Comparator oracle asserts ID 9 sorts before 10 numerically for equal prior keys.
enables: Only the explicitly sequenced dependent contract or adapter slices; not a domain starter's completion or a runtime capability by itself.
goal: Required before/after peer ordering within equal effective urgency; exact integer rank and local deterministic rebalance in `pkgs/fleet/crates/fleet-queue/src/work/priority.rs`; comparator parity in `pkgs/fleet/crates/fleet-queue/src/turso_queue.rs`.
horizon: after design-document merge and granular prerequisites; schema/runtime work has a separate gate
negative_tests: stale, ambiguous, unauthorized, duplicate/replay, partial/unknown effect, and false-completion cases as applicable
oracle: Source-specified model/golden/invariant with a decidable expected result.

goal: atomic local state+journal+intent transaction, immutable intent payload, attempt log/status/event order.
horizon: after design-document merge and granular prerequisites; schema/runtime work has a separate gate
negative_tests: intent absent when state commits, duplicate key, reordered per-target op, DB busy.
oracle: Source-specified model/golden/invariant with a decidable expected result.

enables: Only the explicitly sequenced dependent contract or adapter slices; not a domain starter's completion or a runtime capability by itself.
goal: validate additive graph/journal migration/backfill, rollback, cycle quarantine, event preservation, privacy and Project ownership.
horizon: after design-document merge and granular prerequisites; schema/runtime work has a separate gate
negative_tests: ambiguous ref, cycle, missing principal, telemetry mislabeled journal, private leak, rollback after remote effect.
